turns.text: Hey Lloyd, my coffee maker is leaking again. Any ideas?
That sounds frustrating. Have you checked if the carafe is seated correctly or if the seal is cracked?
The seal looks fine. Maybe it's the valve. Also, I was reading some tech news earlier. Jason Kramberger from Google discussed the reliability of LLM performance benchmarks.
Noted. Benchmark reliability is definitely a hot topic. For the coffee maker, try descaling it; mineral buildup can sometimes affect the valve mechanism.
Will do. I'm actually heading out to dinner soon.
Enjoy! Is there anything else you need help with?
I don't have access to your shipping tracker, Alan. Did you check the email confirmation?
Just got it. It's the new mechanical keyboard. By the way, regarding that conference talk I mentioned, Jason Kramberger presented on the reliability of LLM performance benchmarks.
Got it. So he both discussed and presented on that topic. Let me know if you need help setting up the keyboard drivers.
Yeah, I'll get to that later. It's raining here, so I'm staying in.
Good idea. Let me know if you need any recommendations for indoor activities.
Maybe I'll watch a movie. That's all for now.
Enjoy the rain and the movie!
